text: Huge crater in the middle of 100ft road near Koramangala signal. Two bikers skidded already.
Underground drinking water main broken since morning, clean water flooding the street.
Open sewage manhole without cover right outside primary school gate. Serious danger for kids.
Garbage not picked up for 4 days, foul smell and street dogs scattering waste.
Live wire hanging loose from electrical pole after thunderstorm at 5th cross.
Street lights not working for past 2 weeks between pillar 120 and 130.
Expansion joint on flyover bridge is vibrating dangerously under heavy trucks.
